motion_source.origin: top center; row zero is nearest; no vertical flip
motion_source.excluded_row_fill: linear interpolation; nearest endpoint outside valid rows
motion_source.interpretation: relative display-domain background including unresolved diffuse clutter; not absolute receiver power
motion_source.range_mapping: profile samples span 0 to 10 m; independent of selected sonar range
motion_source.range_extrapolation: hold last measured mean/std beyond 10 m; not measured calibration

frame1.source_format: grayscale JPEG; processed display values, not raw acoustic samples

frame2.source_format: grayscale JPEG; processed display values, not raw acoustic samples

frame3.source_format: grayscale JPEG; processed display values, not raw acoustic samples

assumptions: Top is near in every native image; fan/UI/processed derivatives excluded.
Frame1/255 duplicate, frame_test duplicates, and anomalous-number files are excluded.
5/95% Winsorized SD is conservative; Gaussian display noise cannot reproduce all positive skew or temporal texture.
Stationary 468/625 rows and moving 494 rows are never treated as the same range sampling.
